note: schema_type! resolves a bare source name imported from another crate as that crate's item (a same-named local derive is no longer taken for it, and the diagnostic says another crate); a qualified path through an external crate is refused the same way; a vespera::chrono type keeps its SQL-function default; a qualified-self field type is re-rooted in the source module; nested cfg_attr serde items on adapters are read under the combined predicate; a repeated add entry reports the repeat instead of a source-field collision; undecided serde(into) no longer refuses an adapter; the inline-module chain of each derive reuses the per-content line index instead of re-parsing the file.
